title: 第593章 雪行第596章 寻矿
content_zh:
将妖丹收入一只贴有封灵符的玉盒中，许星遥盘膝坐在岸边，又取出两块上品灵石握在手中，默默运转《太始寒天章》。此地冰属性灵气浓郁，对他的恢复颇有裨益，约莫半个时辰后，消耗大半的灵力便恢复了七七八八，神念的疲惫也缓解了许多。
调息完毕，许星遥并未立刻离开。他站起身，目光投向下方那深不见底的冰湖。那三阶后期的妖龟盘踞于此，想必其巢穴就在湖底。妖兽巢穴附近，往往伴生着一些灵物，这妖龟属性阴寒，其巢穴中说不定就有适合自己的宝物。
“下去看看。”
许星遥心念一动。虽然湖底情况不明，或许还隐藏着未知的危险，但方才神念粗略扫过湖水，并未发现其他强大的生命气息，那妖龟的领地意识极强，应当不会允许同阶妖兽共享巢穴。
他深吸一口气，体内灵力流转，一层淡蓝色的护体灵光浮现在身体表面，将他周身笼罩。随即，他身形一纵，如同一尾游鱼，悄无声息地滑入冰冷的湖水中。
湖水幽寒，光线随着下潜迅速黯淡。水中悬浮着细碎的冰晶，偶尔能看到一些散发着微弱蓝光的浮游生物，如同幽灵般缓缓飘动，为这死寂的深湖增添了几分诡异。
许星遥催动神念，小心地向下探去。湖水极深，他的神念延伸出数十丈，仍未触底，只感到下方传来的寒意越来越重，水压也逐渐增大。那妖龟的妖气残留，在湖水中形成了淡淡的指引，许星遥便循着这微弱的痕迹，缓缓下潜。
下潜了约莫百丈，周围已是一片近乎绝对的黑暗，伸手不见五指，只有护体灵光散发出微弱的光芒，照亮方圆数丈的范围。就在此时，前面斜下方的黑暗中，隐约出现了一片朦胧的微光，并非浮游生物那种散乱的荧光，而是相对集中的稳定光晕。
许星遥精神一振，体内灵力运转加快，加快了下潜速度，同时更加警惕地放出神念探查前方。靠近之后，才发现那微光来自湖底的一处水下洞穴。
洞穴附近的水流似乎都平缓了许多，温度也比周围更低。许星遥在洞口略一停顿，神念仔细扫过洞内，确认没有活物气息，只有浓郁的妖气和精纯的冰寒灵气残留。他这才身形一闪，悄然进入了洞穴之中。
洞穴内部比他想象的还要宽敞，像一个倒扣的巨碗，直径约有十几丈，高度也有数丈。洞壁并非寻常的岩石，而是被打磨得光滑如镜的玄冰，反射着洞内微弱的光源，让整个洞穴光影交错，显得光怪陆离。光源来自洞穴中央，那里堆积着一些散发着柔和白光的寒玉。
而在这些寒玉的中间，生长着两株奇异的植物，这才是许星遥目光的焦点。
这两株植物高约尺许，形态有些像珊瑚，又似鹿角，枝杈分明，仿佛是用最纯净的蓝水晶雕刻而成。植株表面毛茸茸的，覆盖着一层细密的霜花纹路，散发着凛冽的冰寒气息。
“素晶草！”
许星遥眼中闪过一丝喜色。他曾在典籍中见过此物的图鉴和描述，这是一种较为罕见的三阶下品冰属性灵草，通常生长在冰灵气浓郁之地，附近常有强大的妖兽守护。其药性醇厚，是炼制多种有助于玄根初期冰属性修士突破瓶颈丹药的主药之一。
许星遥微微一笑，从储物袋中取出一支寒玉盒和一把玉镰。他先是徒手扒开周围的寒玉，然后用玉镰小心翼翼地割下素晶草，将其放入寒玉盒中，盖上盒盖，贴上封灵符，这才满意地收入储物袋。
两株三阶灵草入手，这趟湖底之行便已不虚。许星遥心情颇佳，又用神念仔细探查了一遍洞穴。洞穴内除了那堆寒玉和妖龟长期盘踞留下的浓重妖气，似乎并无他物。
正当他准备离开时，目光无意中扫过洞穴最深处的冰面。那里被磨得光滑平整，几乎能照出人影。就在那片冰面中心，一点几乎与玄冰本身融为一体的冰蓝色毫光，引起了他的注意。那光芒太淡，若非角度恰好合适，几乎无法察觉。
“嗯？还有东西？”
许星遥走上前去，蹲下身仔细查看。只见在那晶莹的冰层内部约半寸深处，并非镶嵌，而是仿佛天然凝结其中，有一枚龙眼大小的珠子。珠子非金非玉，内部仿佛有氤氲的冰蓝色雾气缓缓流转，散发出的寒意极其纯净。

“这是……寒魄珠？不，不太像。典籍记载的寒魄珠是天地孕育，光华外放，寒气内敛。此物寒气却自然外显，更凝实……”
许星遥仔细观察，心中思索。片刻，他有了猜测：“此物倒更像是那冰龟长期在此修炼，以其精纯的妖力和日夜吸纳的冰湖寒气，经年累月，机缘巧合下凝结而成的一颗“寒煞精华”。其中蕴含的冰寒之力极为庞大，但同时也可能蕴含着妖龟的一丝凶戾妖性，若是直接吸收，恐怕有害无益。
不过，此物若是用来炼器，或者以特殊法门徐徐炼化，提取其中冰寒本源，对冰属性修士而言，益处很大，其价值恐怕还在那两株素晶草之上。
许星遥挥手将其收入储物袋中，准备离开秘境后再仔细研究如何处理。
再次仔细探查，确认再无遗漏后，许星遥不再停留，身形向上浮起，很快便冲出了湖面，落回冰岸之上。
刺骨的寒风再次扑面而来，许星遥定了定神，选定一个大致朝着秘境中心的方向，迈步行去。
越往里走，天地间的景象并未有太大变化，依旧是白茫茫一片，冰峰雪原，寂寥无声。但许星遥能清晰地感觉到，那无处不在的寒气，正以一种缓慢的速度，变得越发浓重。
content_en:
Putting the demon pill into a jade box with a spirit-sealing talisman attached, Xu Xingyao sat cross-legged on the bank, took out two high-grade spirit stones and held them in his hands, silently running the "Taishi Hantian Chapter". The ice attribute spiritual energy here was rich, which was very helpful for his recovery. After about half an hour, most of the spiritual energy he had consumed was restored, and the fatigue of his spiritual mind was also relieved a lot.
After adjusting his breath, Xu Xingyao did not leave immediately. He stood up and looked towards the bottomless icy lake below. The late third-level demon turtle is entrenched here, and its lair must be at the bottom of the lake. There are often some spiritual creatures living near the monster beast's lair. This monster turtle has a cold attribute, so there may be treasures suitable for it in its lair.
"Go down and have a look."
Xu Xingyao thought. Although the situation at the bottom of the lake is unknown, and there may be unknown dangers hidden, but the spiritual mind has just roughly scanned the lake water, and no other powerful life breath has been found. The monster turtle has a strong sense of territory, and it should not allow monsters of the same level to share its lair.
He took a deep breath, and the spiritual energy in his body circulated. A layer of light blue body-protecting spiritual light emerged on the surface of his body, covering him. Immediately, he straightened up like a swimming fish and slid silently into the cold lake water.
The lake is cold, and the light quickly dims as you dive deeper. There are fine ice crystals suspended in the water, and occasionally you can see some plankton emitting a faint blue light, floating slowly like ghosts, adding a bit of weirdness to this deep, dead lake.
Xu Xingyao activated his spiritual thoughts and carefully reached down. The lake was extremely deep, and his spiritual thoughts extended dozens of feet, but he still hadn't touched the bottom. He could only feel the chill coming from below getting heavier and heavier, and the water pressure also gradually increased. The demonic turtle's demonic aura remained, forming a faint guide in the lake water. Xu Xingyao followed this faint trace and dived slowly.
After diving for about a hundred feet, there was almost absolute darkness around him. He couldn't see his fingers at all. Only the protective spiritual light emitted a faint light, illuminating an area of ​​several feet in radius. At this moment, a hazy shimmer appeared in the darkness diagonally below the front. It was not the scattered fluorescence of plankton, but a relatively concentrated and stable halo.
Xu Xingyao's spirit perked up, and the spiritual energy in his body circulated faster, speeding up his dive. At the same time, he released his spiritual thoughts more vigilantly to explore the front. After getting closer, I discovered that the faint light came from an underwater cave at the bottom of the lake.
The water flow near the cave seems to be much gentler, and the temperature is lower than the surrounding area. Xu Xingyao paused for a moment at the entrance of the cave, and scanned the cave carefully with his spiritual mind, confirming that there was no breath of living creatures, and only the rich demonic energy and pure cold spiritual energy remained. Then he flashed and quietly entered the cave.
The inside of the cave was wider than he imagined, like a giant upside-down bowl, with a diameter of about ten feet and a height of several feet. The cave wall is not an ordinary rock, but black ice that has been polished as smooth as a mirror. It reflects the weak light source in the cave, making the entire cave look weird and strange. The light source comes from the center of the cave, where some cold jade emitting soft white light are piled up.
In the middle of these cold jade, there are two strange plants growing. This is the focus of Xu Xingyao's eyes.
The two plants are about a foot tall and look somewhat like coral or antlers. Their branches are distinct, as if they were carved from the purest blue crystal. The surface of the plant is furry, covered with a layer of fine frost patterns, and exudes a biting icy air.
"Sujingcao!"
Xu Xingyao's eyes flashed with joy. He had seen illustrations and descriptions of this thing in classics. It was a relatively rare third-level low-grade ice-attribute spiritual grass. It usually grew in places with strong ice aura, and was often guarded by powerful monsters nearby. Its medicinal properties are mellow, and it is one of the main medicines used to refine a variety of elixirs that can help ice-attribute monks in the early stages of Xuangen break through bottlenecks.
Xu Xingyao smiled slightly and took out a cold jade box and a jade sickle from the storage bag. He first picked apart the cold jade around him with his bare hands, and then used the jade sickle toCarefully cut off the plain crystal grass, put it into the cold jade box, close the lid, affix the sealing talisman, and then put it into the storage bag with satisfaction.
With two third-level spiritual grasses in hand, this trip to the bottom of the lake will be worthwhile. Xu Xingyao was in a good mood and carefully explored the cave again with his spiritual thoughts. There seemed to be nothing in the cave except for the pile of cold jade and the thick demonic aura left by the demon turtle that had been entrenched for a long time.
Just as he was about to leave, his eyes accidentally glanced at the ice in the deepest part of the cave. It was polished so smooth that a human figure could almost be seen. Right in the center of the ice surface, an icy blue light that was almost integrated with the black ice itself caught his attention. The light was so faint that it would be almost undetectable unless the angle was just right.
"Huh? Is there anything else?"
Xu Xingyao walked forward and knelt down to take a closer look. I saw about half an inch deep inside the crystal ice layer. It was not inlaid, but seemed to be naturally condensed. There was a bead the size of a dragon's eye. The beads are neither gold nor jade, and there seems to be a dense icy blue mist inside that is slowly flowing, and the coldness it emits is extremely pure.
"Is this... the cold soul bead? No, it doesn't look like it. The cold soul bead recorded in the classics is conceived by heaven and earth. Its brilliance is released and the cold air is restrained. This object's cold air is naturally exposed and more solid..."
Xu Xingyao observed carefully and thought in his heart. For a moment, he had a guess: "This object is more like a "cold evil essence" that the ice turtle has been practicing here for a long time, with its pure demon power and the cold air of the ice lake absorbed day and night. Over the years, it condensed by chance. The power of ice and cold contained in it is extremely huge, but at the same time, it may also contain a trace of the demon turtle's ferocious demonic nature. If it is absorbed directly, it may be harmful rather than beneficial.
However, if this object is used to refine weapons, or is slowly refined using a special method to extract the ice-cold essence, it will be of great benefit to ice-attribute monks, and its value may still be higher than that of the two prime crystal grasses.
Xu Xingyao waved his hand and put it into his storage bag, preparing to carefully study how to deal with it after leaving the secret realm.
After carefully exploring again and confirming that nothing was missing, Xu Xingyao stopped staying, floated upwards, and soon rushed out of the lake and landed back on the ice bank.
The biting cold wind hit his face again. Xu Xingyao calmed down, chose a direction roughly toward the center of the secret realm, and walked away.
As we walked further in, the scene between heaven and earth did not change much. It was still a vast expanse of white, ice peaks and snowfields, and silence. But Xu Xingyao could clearly feel that the cold air everywhere was becoming thicker and thicker at a slow speed.
